method: Actual current-Windows-user Tauri fixture and system folder dialogs, operated and observed through authorized Computer Use. Filtered assertions were evaluated against captured accessibility trees; visual observations are separately labelled. No raw Shell navigation tree or account-path screenshot is published.

visualObservations: Default parent was selected before any dialog; project name Creme with an accented e produced a stable creme-field-study destination.
Tab focused Change folder; Return opened the actual owned system dialog; Escape cancelled it and visibly returned focus to Change folder.
Cancellation preserved the friendly name, default parent and destination; read-only fixture inspection found no project child.
A separately created empty synthetic Unicode/spaces/emoji directory was selected through the actual dialog; the displayed parent and destination preserved its characters.
Selecting the same empty directory through Open's picker enabled explicit Open but did not open a project; no Open/Create action was submitted.

cases.reason: The observer's 180-second admission deadline elapsed before the first chooser action. A visible owned modal and draft were observed, but no automatic lock event occurred. Escape and ordinary close recovered the fixture; no lock success is inferred.

cases.acceptanceBoundary: AC5/AC6: lock must dismiss a pending actual native dialog and clear protected form state
cases.recovery: The operator sent Escape only to the remaining folder dialog, never invoked unlock/authentication, then closed the synthetic locked window.

cases.acceptanceBoundary: AC5/AC6: main-window close must dismiss a pending actual native dialog without waiting for user cancellation
cases.recovery: Operator Escape cancelled the folder dialog; only then did cleanup and the already requested main-window close complete.

requiredReplay: Correct native cancellation delivery; replay actual visible lock and main-close, plus ordinary selection/cancellation on the corrected candidate. Existing manually pumped unshown-COM tests do not prove Shell modal-loop cancellation.
scopeLimits: Working-source observations, not exact-commit task evidence or independent task disposition.
Not production packaging, Windows authentication, real-account policy, or W1 qualification.
Default parent in GUI fixture is substituted. Actual debug/release default resolution and real Core creation require separate proof.
